title: Central Sleep Apnea
subtitle: Definitions, symptoms, evaluation, management, safety, and evidence related to central sleep apnea.
evidence_strength: Moderate evidence supports use of positive airway pressure therapy in CSA patients without systolic heart failure; evidence in heart failure populations is mixed with some safety concerns noted; supplemental oxygen shows symptomatic benefit; emerging pharmacologic therapies require further study.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
